verdict.rationale: Adyen is API-first, so it runs headlessly by design. Integrations are driven entirely by server-side Checkout API calls (/sessions, /payments, /payments/details), with idempotency keys for safe retries and webhooks for asynchronous status. A separate test environment with test credentials supports automated testing, and scoped API credentials keep machine access least-privilege. The MCP server runs non-interactively via `npx -y @adyen/mcp --env=TEST`, with the key supplied through an environment variable, which suits scripted or CI use. Missing for 10: an official CLI, explicit CI-pipeline or test-automation guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration of headless/CI usage.
